A bookshelf holds 12 books. Every mathematics book is thicker than every poetry book, and there are twice as many poetry books as mathematics books. Three of the remaining books are atlases, and the rest are dictionaries. Each dictionary is thinner than a poetry book. If the thickest book is 5 cm thick and the whole row of books measures 36 cm, explain step by step how many dictionaries there are and whether a dictionary can be 3 cm thick.
